exposure_description: A status query unexpectedly returned completed-task summaries from other agents, including parent-study review labels/counts and a summary of the already-sealed 9213 ambiguity. No other review files or raw rater labels were opened. The summaries also described unrelated packaging work. They were not used as criterion evidence.
pending_delegated_exposure_scope: The delegated reviewer was not shown the returned summaries. Its three pending records are included in a coordinator-exposed batch and will carry the exposure metadata if not already sealed.
remaining_supplemental_review_scope: All supplemental sessions not listed as already sealed, including packets not yet exported. The coordinator will not claim those remaining reviews are fully label-blind.

required_remaining_record_field.scope: Limited exposure to unrelated parent-study completed-review summaries; no automatic/raw-rater labels or outcome evidence, and no use of another reviewer's label as evidence.

remediation: Avoid further collaboration.list_agents calls. Do not rewrite sealed reviews. Preserve this note separately; fresh positive-case review may be performed in an unexposed context under root direction.

delegated_record_status_clarification.status: The delegated reviewer reported all three records had already been sealed by exclusive creation before the coordinator's exposure-metadata message arrived. Their exact seal timing relative to the coordinator's status-tool exposure is not asserted. The delegated reviewer did not see the other-review summaries and did not open other reviews.

final_supplemental_batch_scope.metadata_requirement: Each of these 15 newly created records must carry other_review_summary_exposure:true with the limited coordinator exposure explained. Delegates received no other-world verdicts during this batch, and verdicts/quotes are held until all 24 records are sealed.
